title: Bahçeşehir hair salon prices 2026: what do a haircut, color and balayage cost?
seoTitle: Bahçeşehir Hair Salon Prices 2026: Cut, Color | Emrahair
description: Bahçeşehir hair salon prices for 2026: haircut, blow-dry, root color, balayage, keratin and manicure. See what sets the price and how to read the ranges.
lede: On Emrahair’s 2026 price list, a women’s haircut is [[24-1]], a blow-dry is [[22-1]], Italian root color is [[575809-1]] and balayage is [[243987-1]]. Below you will find what moves a salon price up or down, why most prices are written as ranges, and every category on the menu.

sections.heading: How much does a haircut cost?
body: At Emrahair, a women’s haircut (Saç Kesimi on the Turkish list) is [[24-1]], and cuts are done by Emrah Çabkur and Serdar Sezer. Where you land in that range mostly depends on the length and density of your hair: fine, shoulder-length hair and thick hair that reaches the waist simply do not take the same time.

If you only want a blow-dry: a classic blow-dry (Fön) is [[22-1]], a textured blow-dry (Kırık Fön) that leaves soft movement and volume at the ends is [[221-1]], and curling-iron styling (Maşa) for defined curls is [[23-1]]. A blow-dry can be booked on its own, without a cut. For cut styles and blow-dry options, see our [haircut and blow-dry page](/sac-kesimi).

sections.heading: What sets the price at a hair salon?
body: It can seem odd that the same service is priced differently for two people. In practice, the price depends less on the name of the service and more on the condition of your hair and the work it needs. Most salons weigh these five factors together:
list: Length and density: long, thick hair needs more product and more time.
Previous color: getting a new shade to sit evenly on hair that has already been colored or lightened usually takes more steps than on natural hair.
Technique: hand-painted lightening such as balayage is longer and more detailed work than a single all-over color.
Time: some color services take hours, and time in the chair shows up directly in the price.
Product: the amount of color, lightener and treatment used grows with the length of the hair.

sections.heading: Why are so many prices shown as ranges?
body: Emrahair’s prices are the list the salon publishes on its Kolay Randevu booking page, and every price in this article comes from that list. Many services appear as a range rather than a single number, because the price depends on the length and density of the hair.

The final price is confirmed at the chair, after your hair has been seen and before the service starts. That way you know where you fall in the range before anything begins. A few services are listed without a price; those are quoted once the stylist has seen your hair.

When you ask about a price by phone or message, mention your hair length, when it was last colored and in what shade, and the result you are hoping for: it narrows the range you will be given. If you can, share a recent daylight photo of your hair and a photo of the look you like.

sections.heading: Root color and full color prices
body: Root color is one of the most searched prices, since covering grays or refreshing grown-out roots is a regular need. On Emrahair’s list, Italian root color is [[575809-1]], ammonia-free root color is [[372904-1]] and Igora root color is [[376225-1]]. Root lift and color, which lightens and tones the roots, is listed at [[250659-1]]. How often roots need redoing depends on how fast your hair grows and how much gray there is; for most people the regrowth shows every few weeks.

For the whole head, full color is [[26-1]] and highlights and lowlights are [[29-1]]. Which option suits you depends on your current color and the shade you are aiming for. The details are on our [hair color page](/sac-boyama).

sections.heading: Balayage prices: Air Touch, sombré and ombré
body: Balayage has one of the widest price ranges on the list. Air Touch balayage is [[383324-1]] and is done by Emrah Çabkur. Classic balayage is [[243987-1]], ombré is [[219-1]], the softer sombré is [[191804-1]] and brushlight is [[345954-1]].

The reason for the wide range is simple: getting a light result on hair that falls below the waist and has been dyed dark before takes far more time and product than working on natural, shoulder-length hair. When going from very dark to very light, spreading the work over more than one session is usually recommended to protect the hair. You can compare the techniques on our [balayage page](/balyaj).

sections.heading: Keratin, nails, brows and waxing prices
body: For treatments, a keratin smoothing treatment is [[301244-1]], keratin botox is [[301248-1]] and a hair glaze is [[237974-1]]. With keratin, too, the price follows the length and density of the hair.

A manicure is [[33-1]], a pedicure is [[34-1]] and gel polish on the hands is [[67-1]]. Brow shaping is [[35-1]] and a brow tint is [[175-1]]. For waxing, underarms are [[571323-1]], arms [[571322-1]], legs [[571325-1]] and full body [[41-1]]. Nails, brows and waxing are done by Gizem Değişener. To see every item on one page, open the full [services and price list](/hizmetler).

sections.heading: What to look for when choosing a hair salon
body: Price matters, but it is not the only thing to check. Whether you are in Bahçeşehir or anywhere else, these points make the choice easier:
list: Published prices: a salon that shows its prices openly lets you know what to expect. If a price is a range, ask whether the final price is confirmed before the service starts.

A conversation before color: before any color or balayage, your hair history, the target shade and how many sessions it may take should be discussed. An appointment that skips this step leaves room for surprises.
Portfolio and Instagram: look at posts showing real clients’ hair, and look for examples close to your own hair type and the color you want.

Reviews with a clear source: check where reviews are published and how many ratings they are based on. For example, Emrahair is rated 4.9 from 297 ratings on Kolay Randevu and 4.8 from 43 ratings on Google.
Hygiene: a clean workspace, tools cleaned between clients and a careful setup for nail services are easy to notice on a first visit.

At Emrahair, Italian root color is [[575809-1]], ammonia-free root color is [[372904-1]] and Igora root color is [[376225-1]]. Root lift and color is listed at [[250659-1]]. The options differ in the type of color and how much of the hair is treated.

At Emrahair, a classic blow-dry is [[22-1]], a textured blow-dry is [[221-1]] and curling-iron styling is [[23-1]]. Blow-dries are done by Emrah Çabkur, Serdar Sezer, Merve Aydemir and Zeynep Aydemir. Hair length decides where you fall in the range.
